node.name: Purple_Mush_Cap
node.description: According to herblore books, this purple cap is sterile. Those purple fungi that grow from the ground, however, will mutate if exposed to toxic oil radiation.

quest:Nebula_Neddy1.name: Task_Requirement_Affirmative
quest:Nebula_Neddy1.description: Gather some monster parts to show you're ready to take on the World 4 tasks!

quest:Rift_Ripper1.name: Entering_The_Rift...
quest:Rift_Ripper1.description: Get these random items to gain access to The Rift.

item:Ladle.name: Cooking_Ladle
item:Ladle.description: Hold down to boost all your kitchens ahead by 1 hour for each ladle in this stack. The entire stack will be used up when you do.

item:PetEgg.name: Mob_Egg
item:PetEgg.description: Hold down to instantly incubate eggs for your nest in World 4. It'll only use up eggs that you have space to carry, dont worry about wasting these!

item:PureWater2.name: Dense_Water
item:PureWater2.description: It's like a bowl of oatmeal, but double the thiccness and hold the oats.

item:GalaxyA2.name: TV_Remote
item:GalaxyA2.description: Oh, THATS where he put the remote, all the way out here in outer space thousands of miles from the surface! Oh that silly man!

item:GalaxyA3.name: Half_Eaten_Donut
item:GalaxyA3.description: WAIT NO STOP! Don't eat the rest of this donut! Think about it... if it was really worth eating, why was it left like this, all un-eaten and such? Think before you eat!

item:Quest70.name: Phone_Box
item:Quest70.description: IdleOn is out on iOS devices! The Rift Ripper must have kept a few of these back when he played during the iOS Launch event... Hold down to open, and a random reward will drop at your feet!

item:Quest71.name: Gem_Envelope
item:Quest71.description: Contains a random number of gems, hold down to open! It could be just a couple gems, but it could also have as many as 10,000 gems!

item:Timecandy9.name: Cosmic_Time_Candy
item:Timecandy9.description: Hold down to get anywhere from 5 hours to 500 hours of AFK time! Gives 24 hrs on average. Odds are: 54% for 5-10hr, 25% for 10-25hr, 18% for 25-100 hr, 2.1% for 100-499hr, 0.4% for 500hr.

item:GalaxyA2b.name: Lost_Batteries
item:GalaxyA2b.description: Oh, THATS why the remote wasn't working when I pushed the buttons, the batteries were all the way out here in the rare drop table!

item:GalaxyA1.name: Purple_Mush_Cap
item:GalaxyA1.description: According to herblore books, this purple cap is sterile. Those purple fungi that grow from the ground, however, will mutate if exposed to toxic oil radiation.

pageProps.seoDescription: Purple Mush Cap is a Legends of Idleon item: dropped by 1 monster, used in 2 recipes, quest reward. According to herblore books, this purple cap is sterile. Those purple fungi that grow from the ground, however, will mutate if exposed to toxic oil radiation.
